tunnel_engines.split_tunneling: project-owned Rust D-Bus/netlink/eBPF service, wire-compatible with Proton daemon 0.13.8

implemented_from_official_contracts.authentication: SRP, TOTP, FIDO2, organization SSO and Human Verification
implemented_from_official_contracts.protocols: Smart, ProTun UDP/TCP/TLS-Stealth and OpenVPN UDP/TCP when advertised
implemented_from_official_contracts.protection: standard/advanced Kill Switch, NetShield, VPN Accelerator, Moderate NAT, port forwarding, IPv6 and IPv6 leak protection
implemented_from_official_contracts.anti_censorship: Alternative Routing through the official Proton DoH naming scheme and Windows alternative-host TLS pins
implemented_from_official_contracts.connection_observation: traffic counters, Local Agent NetShield counters, forwarded port and P2P restriction reason 86153
implemented_from_official_contracts.product_data: profiles, recents, favorites, Default Connection, excluded locations and Connect and Go/private launch
implemented_from_official_contracts.support: connection feedback statistical events, report issue, bounded diagnostics, account and upgrade handoff

project_extensions.split_tunneling_ip_ranges: IPv4/IPv6 hosts and CIDRs are canonicalized, persisted and enforced with UID-scoped LPM maps at connect/sendmsg hooks.
project_extensions.local_area_network_access_policy: Private, unique-local and link-local destinations use the same Proton bypass mark through a separate authenticated policy map.
project_extensions.local_dns_access_policy: Only exact private/link-local physical resolvers plus mDNS/LLMNR multicast destinations bypass; public resolvers are never imported from the physical link.
project_extensions.split_tunneling_route_ownership: Kill Switch coexistence routes are UID-scoped, tagged, durably tracked and removed by exact route/rule identity; foreign tables or priorities cause a fail-closed collision error and are never flushed.

platform_policy.updates: Arch/Omarchy package lifecycle replaces the Windows in-app updater
platform_policy.openvpn_adapter: NetworkManager uses a Linux TUN interface; Windows TUN/TAP driver selection is not portable
platform_policy.protocol_visibility: Only exact installed/advertised backends are selectable
